pages.text: A small protein folds all at once or not at all. Its stability is ΔG = ΔH(1 − T/Tm) − m·U (U the denaturant), and the folded share is 1/(1 + e^(−ΔG/RT)). Near its melting point Tm half the chains are unfolded.
$(thing)Set$(): Temperature, Denaturant.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Stray salt: stability varies by ±2%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The chains clump together.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Warmer folds faster.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Folding stability: ΔG = ΔH(1 − T/Tm) − m·U$(br)Folded share: f = 1/(1 + e^(−ΔG/RT))
